doctrine: Extract the full system inventory (HVAC, DHW, envelope, controls, electrical service) with install years and condition ratings before proposing anything — you cannot stage what you haven't inventoried
Pull the immediate-repairs table verbatim: these are near-term forced capital events that any retrofit measure must be sequenced around, not competed against
Pull the deferred/replacement-reserve capex schedule separately from immediate repairs — this is where load-reduction-before-replacement and re-roof/re-plant piggybacking opportunities live

Cross-reference audit findings against PCA condition ratings: an audit-recommended measure on equipment the PCA rates as fair/poor is a near-term staging candidate; the same measure on equipment rated good/excellent is a defer-to-end-of-life candidate
Treat modeled savings figures in the audit as provisional until a measured baseline (utility/interval data) is available to validate them
origination_prompts: Has every major system (roof, HVAC, DHW, controls/BAS, electrical service, envelope) been assigned a condition rating and remaining-useful-life estimate?
Is there an immediate-repairs table, and does it name dollar amounts and forced timelines?
Is there a 5-10 year deferred capex / reserve schedule, and which line items overlap with retrofit opportunity families (roof -> envelope, HVAC plant -> hvac, water heater -> dhw)?
Does the audit's savings estimate rely on modeled assumptions the PCA's system inventory can validate or contradict (e.g. claimed RTU efficiency vs actual nameplate/age)?
feasibility_checks: Confirm the PCA's data is recent enough (typically within 1-3 years) to be trusted for condition ratings; stale PCAs need a site walk to re-verify major systems
Reconcile any conflicts between the PCA's equipment list and the energy audit's equipment list before building a staging plan on either alone
Check that the immediate-repairs table's dollar figures and the deferred capex schedule are both budgeted somewhere in ownership's plan, not just noted
data_requirements: energy audit report if separate from PCA
utility billing history if available at this stage
